# WatchPulse (https://watchpulse.online)

> WatchPulse is an independent movie and TV series discovery guide and editorial publication created by Awais K and hosted on Cloudflare Pages. WatchPulse pairs TVmaze series metadata (CC BY-SA), Wikipedia (CC BY-SA) & Wikidata (CC0) film profiles, official YouTube trailers, and 20 original long-form editorial guides and reviews. WatchPulse is not a streaming provider and does not supply live per-country streaming availability feeds.

## Editorial Guides & Reviews (20 Original Articles)
- [Editorial Guides Hub](https://watchpulse.online/guides): Complete index of 20 original editorial comparisons, curated runtime collections, and film/TV reviews.
- [10 Tight, High-Tension Thrillers Under 100 Minutes](https://watchpulse.online/guide-short-thrillers-under-100-minutes): Curated runtime and pacing guide with key details and editorial verdicts.

- [Netflix vs. Prime Video vs. Apple TV+ vs. HBO Max in 2026](https://watchpulse.online/guide-netflix-vs-prime-video-vs-apple-tv-2026): Independent editorial comparison of subscription catalogs, video tiers, and rental vs. subscription distinctions.

- [Dune: Part Two & Modern Sci-Fi Epics at Home Review](https://watchpulse.online/review-dune-part-two-and-modern-sci-fi-epics): Critical review, home audio/display calibration advice, and viewing verdict.
- [Best Free Legal Movie Streaming Apps in 2026](https://watchpulse.online/guide-best-free-legal-movie-streaming-apps-2026): First-hand 2026 test of free legal ad-supported apps (YouTube, Plex, Tubi, Pluto TV, Kanopy) covering geo-blocks in South Asia, ad interruptions, and which genres survive ad breaks.
- [8 Acclaimed Limited Series You Can Finish in One Weekend](https://watchpulse.online/guide-best-mini-series-to-binge-in-one-weekend): Self-contained miniseries under 10 episodes with listed runtimes and zero cliffhangers.
- [The Golden Age of Prestige Sci-Fi TV: 8 Essential Series](https://watchpulse.online/guide-best-sci-fi-tv-shows-streaming-right-now): Modern sci-fi TV series compared by concept, pacing, and completion status.
- [What to Watch If You Loved Knives Out: 8 Clever Whodunits](https://watchpulse.online/guide-movies-like-knives-out-and-glass-onion): Ensemble murder mysteries and crime comedies compared by clue playfulness and wit.
- [8 Smartest Heist Movies Ever Made](https://watchpulse.online/guide-best-heist-movies-ranked-by-cleverness): Heist films ranked by planning cleverness and clockwork misdirection rather than spectacle.

- [8 Smart Comfort Comedies for Stressful Weeknights](https://watchpulse.online/guide-comfort-comedies-for-stressful-weeknights): Warm, witty low-stress comedies evaluated for stressful weeknights.
- [7 Gripping Courtroom & Legal Thrillers](https://watchpulse.online/guide-best-courtroom-and-legal-dramas): Dialogue-driven courtroom dramas and corporate legal thrillers that shine on any screen.
- [8 Practical Action Movies Like John Wick](https://watchpulse.online/guide-movies-like-john-wick-practical-action): Stunt-driven martial arts and espionage action films featuring clean spatial choreography.
- [Streaming in Pakistan, India & South Asia (2026)](https://watchpulse.online/guide-streaming-guide-for-pakistan-india-and-south-asia): How streaming rights split between the US, India, and Pakistan, with a subscription decision tree.

## Core Pages & Transparency
- [Discovery Catalog](https://watchpulse.online/): Search movies and TV series, view cast/directors/runtimes, watch official trailers, or take the Tonight's Pick Quiz.
- [30-Second Movie Finder Quiz](https://watchpulse.online/movie-finder): Interactive movie and TV picker by mood, available runtime, format, and language with shareable results.
- [About WatchPulse](https://watchpulse.online/about): Mission, creator information, open data stack, and non-affiliation disclosure.
- [Contact & Editorial Corrections](https://watchpulse.online/contact): Direct contact form and metadata correction reporting (`awaiskniazi786@gmail.com`).
- [Privacy Policy](https://watchpulse.online/privacy): Transparent disclosure of `localStorage`, Google Analytics (`GTM-PTPLM5VB`), Google AdSense cookies, Consent Mode v2, Cloudflare Pages, FormSubmit, and TVmaze/Wikipedia/Wikidata/YouTube usage.
- [Terms of Service](https://watchpulse.online/terms): Editorial discovery scope, open data attribution, trademark disclaimers, and DMCA contact.
